notes.title: Patch #6 (Medium Mark B)
notes.notes:
Dear Tankers,

Sorry for the long wait! We have been busy working on adding new features to the Sandbox game mode (more sneak peek will come later in a separate article). 

Today in the limelight will be the addition of the new whippet, Medium Mark B, to the game! 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/E9xCwt1.gif[/img]

Be sure to restart Steam so that the patch (v0.2.6a) downloads.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
[h1]Medium Mark B[/h1]
To better exploit breaches in enemy lines, Medium Mark B was designed to be longer to aid in trench crossing and had larger fuel capacity. Unlike Mark A, the engine and fuel tank is located at the rear in a separate compartment.

Medium Mark B can be unlocked from his predecessor Medium Mark A Whippet.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33806715/365ad52e7227db2e25bd3d01a002394327b97a4b.png[/img]

Fitted with 7 gun ports, Medium Mark B packed some intense all-round firepower!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33806715/4a56337e24ef5c1ed84dbfd46da140252288620b.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33806715/0506143833552196e7320222001456a4535d7434.png[/img]

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
- Improved tank steering on steep slope. Reduced sliding left/right when going up slope.
- Fixed inaccurate add on front armor (light and medium) on Mark IX.

Armored Battle Crew Team

notes.title: Patch #5 (Sandbox game mode, Mark IX & 20% Off)
notes.notes:
Dear Tankers,

We are pleased to release the new Sandbox game mode! You can access the Sandbox via the battle button in the garage.

Be sure to restart Steam so that the patch downloads.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33806715/ad47f24025976cab8d72c1921c95d67f8d5c07a3.png[/img]

Currently, there are 2 maps for you to use in the Sandbox.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33806715/391ad58cb0cf82c7950c5e0689edccbcb5aa4395.png[/img]

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
[h1]Sandbox Main Features[/h1]

[b]Placement of Units[/b]

You can place ally and enemy units (infantry, tanks, plane, crew served weapons) on the map.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33806715/cbbea790769fd56b5be34173db801c0c4c5932b7.png[/img]

[b]Choose your vehicle[/b]

You can easily select one of the vehicles from your garage!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33806715/4b3b22b6a73b1119153d1a35c860b70e074424ca.png[/img]

[b]Setting[/b]

You can set the time of the day and difficulty.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33806715/6709899cc3c1dfd321346c3e25b9b7dde81a458a.png[/img]

[b]Steam Workshop[/b]

The Sandbox is integrated with the Steam Workshop. You can download the Sandbox mission by using the Workshop page on Steam. Browse and subscribe the mod you are interested and it will download. Load up the game and you can play them!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33806715/bf5625205b40cd574486b4d2deda75c5c20ad313.png[/img]

You can also upload the Sandbox mission you have created via the Manage Mod panel in the garage. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33806715/18d9da4fa275f1e910fe4fd2ac6e584e1399d123.png[/img]

More features will be considered down the road!

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
[h1]Mark IX[/h1]
Mark IX was designed to carry troops into the battlefield to help hold the ground. It was nicknamed the “pig” due to the  snout-like front hull.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33806715/6551c9faf92b7bd13613b8f94ee9432fc199eccd.png[/img]

Fitted with 11 storage slots, it can house a great range of extra troopers, ammo or fuel. It can be unlocked from the Tech Tree via Mark V Female.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33806715/3639a7161de665d93661f10770e65c8ade5708bc.png[/img]

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
[h1]20% Off for a limited time![/h1]
Last but not least, get the game now for 20% off!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33806715/a8bd44b26d6d4a35522bd64f0d5f1a9cd2090d88.png[/img]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/814740/Armored_Battle_Crew_World_War_1__Tank_Warfare_and_Crew_Management_Simulator/

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
[h1]Need more info?[/h1]
You can find more detailed information about the new Sandbox game mode in the Guides Section!

https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1905796305

https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1905768669

https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1905642725

Armored Battle Crew Team

notes.title: Patch #4
notes.notes:
Hey Tankers,
The latest update with RNAS Armored Car is finally here! More details below.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33806715/bf70e2695737cb2be9f86155687752bd316a4f97.png[/img]

Be sure to restart Steam so that the patch downloads.

[h1]Build v0.2.4b Change Log:[/h1]
[b]New Vehicle[/b]
[list]
[*] RNAS Armored Car is unlocked by default. You can add it to the garage by using the “Create New” button or the “+” on the tank carousel.
[*] RNAS Armored Car will have tow line abilities (front and rear) to pull the vehicle out of trouble. You can access them via the steering module.
[*] RNAS Armored Car will have 3 turrets to choose from. Access them from the Arsenal panel in the garage.
[/list]

[b]New Features[/b]
[list]
[*] You can now use shortcut “J” to order your crew to repair the manned module. Shortcut key can be modified in the Options menu.
[*] The speed of the Slow Mo mode can now be tweaked in the Options under the gameplay tab. Default value is 0.3.
[/list]

[b]New Campaign Mission[/b]
[list]
[*] Added a new Campaign Mission IV (Chipilly Spur) to Battle of Amiens
[/list]

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed issue with the Train derailing in Mission Panzerzug
[*] Fixed issue with Mark V Star Wide track incorrect terrain resistance value
[/list]

[b]Other Changes[/b]
[list]
[*] To address the issue of Tank slot setting getting reset, we have created a new folder, named “TanksData”, to store the tank slot setting and it is marked for Steam cloud save. But the changes will only be applied after the patch is installed. Which mean that is still a chance Steam will reset the tank slots when the patch is installed. Just in case, you can backup the old “Tanks” folder in the game installation folder.  
[/list]

Do let us know your feedback through:
[url=https://discord.gg/gattaigames]Discord[/url]
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/814740/discussions/]Steam Forums[/url]

Armored Battle Crew Team

notes.title: Patch #2
notes.notes:
Hey Tankers,
We have pushed out the latest patch. More details below!

Be sure to restart Steam so that the patch downloads.

[h1]Build v0.2.2 Change Log:[/h1]
[b]Main Changes[/b]
[list]
[*] 1.59 Inch Vickers is now unlocked right at the start to give Mark V Female and Whippet access to Anti-Tank weapon
[*] Whippet is now unlocked right at the start to offer players more variety of vehicles to choose from
[/list]

[b]To ease the learning curve, we have adjusted Mission 1, 2 and 3[/b]
[list]
[*] Enemy Tanks will not be spawned on Easy difficulty for Mission 1 and 2
[*] Enemy artillery strikes are less often on Easy difficulty for Mission 1 and 2 
[*] Enemy Tank at the start of Mission 3 is replaced with an AT gun on Easy difficulty
[/list]

[b]Quality of Life Improvement[/b]
[list]
[*] Killing the crew of AT gun and machine gun will now be counted as a kill on the objective counter in Mission 3 and 4. (But do destroy the gun completely if you wish to earn some additional XP)
[*] All flamethrowers default target type is set to both Infantry and Soft (Used to be just Infantry). Hint: Flamethrower can arc over the AT gun and kill the crew
[*] Mark V ability to crush obstacles have been greatly improved. Weight of vehicle will now be factored into the rate of destruction of obstacles
[*] Prompt to enter Garage in Main Menu is removed
[*] To aid in finding the downed plane in mission 5, the plane debris are scattered in a larger radius around the crashed site. "Capture Pilot" has also been renamed to "Rescue Pilot"
[*] Shortcut keys for Ability 1 ('Q'), Ability 2 ('E'), Cycle Ammo ('F') are now remappable under Option
[*] Crew will now auto take up position in the vehicle at the start of battle
[*] In Mission 6, on completion of all objectives except “Destroy Artillery”, enemy artillery will spawn instantly instead of needing to wait
[/list]

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed mission 6 minimap showing accessible part of the map as inaccessible
[*] Fix Light armor not working on Female Sponson on Mark V Female and Composite
[/list]

[b]Useful Tips:[/b]
[list]
[*] Do use Smoke or Star shell from the signal module as they are cheap and recharge fast. Smoke provides cover from enemy fire and Star shell temporarily blind enemy infantry.
[*] Ramming enemy Anti-Tank gun can be the quickest way to kill it. Pop smoke before closing it.
[/list]

Do let us know your feedback through:
[url=https://discord.gg/gattaigames]Discord[/url]
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/814740/discussions/]Steam Forums[/url]

Armored Battle Crew Team

notes.title: Patch #1
notes.notes:
Hey Tankers,
We are addressing some of the balancing issues the community has voiced out since launch. 

Be sure to restart Steam so that the patch downloads.

Build v0.2.1 Change Log:
[list]
[*] Resupply point will now give 50 fuel every 10s instead of 30 fuel every 10s
[*] Small supply drop will now give 75 fuel instead of 50 fuel
[*] 6 Pounder and 3 Pounder accuracy improved by 10%
[*] Accuracy drop caused by moving and turning the tank greatly improved
[*] Damage taken has been reduced in medium and hard difficulty (up to 15%)
[*] AT Mine damage is reduced by 30%
[*] AT Mine blast radius is reduced by 25%
[*] Enemy Anti-Tank gun reload speed increased from 3s to 6s
[*] Mark V tanks off road mobility improved by 20%
[*] XP multiplier on Defeat is buffed from x1 to x1.25
[*] Difficulty XP multiplier buffed up to +60%
[/list]

Quick Reminder:
[list]
[*] Use 'R' to order your crew to auto pick up ammo and return back to   the weapon
[*] Use 'H' to order your crew to auto heal once and return back to previous module
[/list]

Do let us know your feedback through:
[url=https://discord.gg/gattaigames]Discord[/url]
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/814740/discussions/]Steam Forums[/url]

Armored Battle Crew Team
